answer: Each agent registers by locking a stake and submitting a TEE attestation signed with a key fused into its CPU core; the quote includes a physically unclonable function of that core and a location hash. The economy’s atlas bins active identities by a 200-meter radius, so an attacker who rents a thousand cores on one knoll gets only one voting unit, while a thousand agents in a garden of separate households each get a unit. Duplicate PUF quotes are slashed, and renting distinct locations costs the attacker real estate and per-core stake.
